scope_limits: No scheduler, solver, original validator or thermal integrator called.
Stored continuous thermal enclosures are audited arithmetically, not regenerated.
Three single R1 HEFT runs do not prove optimality, performance generality or an overall schedulability rate.

Only deadlines change: the same fixed schedule retains the same physical energy/thermal trajectory. Different returned energy comes from different selected OPP/timing under finite search, not a new physical power model.
All visited candidates SAFE and final peaks far below 80 C; thermal constraints/feedback selection effects are not demonstrated.
theoretical_domain_note: Relaxing only deadlines nests feasible domains and makes the exact optimum nonincreasing when defined; the three finite HEFT outcomes do not certify any exact optimum or general heuristic monotonicity.
